test_cases.summary:

Feature: Default Session Status Selection
Scenario: Default status set on form load
Given the user opens the Create Session form

Then the Session Status field should be pre-selected as “Yet to do”
test_cases.acceptance:

The behavior should be validated when the form finishes loading.

Scenario: No placeholder shown when default applied

test_cases.acceptance:

The behavior should be validated when Session Status is displayed.

test_cases.summary:
Verify User can change default value
when "Yet to do" is selected by default
test_cases.description:
Feature: Default Session Status Selection
Scenario: User can change default value
Given “Yet to do” is selected by default
When the user selects “In Progress”

test_cases.acceptance:
The Session Status field should update to "In Progress"
The behavior should be validated when the user selects "In Progress".

test_cases.summary:

test_cases.acceptance:

The behavior should be validated when the session is submitted.

test_cases.summary:

test_cases.acceptance:

test_cases.summary:

Feature: Default Session Status Selection
